g.title: HR_SURVEY
g.text: Survey - This datasource returns data relating to a survey.
Survey code, used for identifiying it.
This is the purpose of the survey.
This field stores the reference to a questionnaire from the catalogue.
The identifier of the Survey Privacy Settings entity.
Activate this flag to allow an external component to calculate the answer sentiment.
Latest date for the submission of answers.
Activate this flag to prevent new participants being added to the survey.
The person who created the survey.
The Identifier of the OrgUnit record.
The Identifier of the Functional Area record.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
